bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY AFTERNOON... Combined seas 13 to 16 feet. Bar conditions severe. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 815 AM Sunday, 800 PM Sunday, and 915 AM Monday.
